name: fraction_role
description: Identify numerator versus denominator of an explicit fraction; control identifies the displayed integer in that role.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(100):
 a,b=random.sample(range(1,10),2);upper=bool(i%2);v=a if upper else b;role='numerator' if upper else 'denominator';words='zero one two three four five six seven eight nine'.split()
 prefix=f'Consider the fraction {a}/{b}. '
 items.append({'prompt':prefix+f'The number {v} is the numerator or denominator? Answer:', 'answer':' '+role})
 control.append({'prompt':prefix+f'What is the {role}? Answer in one English word:', 'answer':' '+words[v]})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
